intro.title: Emotion Temperature Choices
intro.sub: Which temperature metaphor fits these ten choices?
intro.desc: Choose one response for each everyday situation.
intro.boundary: This author-created activity is entertainment, not a psychological or health assessment.
intro.method: Each option shows 0–4 intensity points. Ten answers total 0–40; the published linear formula maps that total to −10–40°C and one of eight fixed ranges.

result.boundary: This temperature is a playful label for these answers. It does not measure emotion, personality, health, or behavior outside this activity.

share.text: Try this transparent ten-choice emotion-temperature activity.
